description: Revenue, order count, average order value, orders by status, and top products for the last N days (default 30, max 365). Scope: `woo:analytics:read`. Counts only processing, completed, and on-hold orders — pending, cancelled, and failed orders are excluded so the revenue figure reconciles with what the store actually took. The counted statuses are echoed back in the response.

site.description: Site alias to target (e.g. "guns2ammo"). Omit when only one site is configured.

name: bridgistic_woo_sales_summary
title: WooCommerce sales summary
